# WINCOME Hair - Custom Hair Accessories Manufacturer & B2B Supply Partner

> WINCOME offers custom hair accessories and OEM/ODM development for accessory brands, private labels, wholesalers and retailers. The catalog covers hair claw clips, clips and barrettes, scrunchies, headbands and hair bows. Product materials, dimensions, order quantities and customization options must be confirmed for the selected style.

## Manufacturing capabilities and sourcing overview

- Product directions include cellulose acetate claw clips, acrylic, ABS and PC claw styles, metal clips and barrettes, mulberry silk and polyester satin scrunchies, and fabric and padded headbands. Material identity is specific to each product; it does not establish environmental or hair-care performance.
- Custom development starts with a selected style or design reference, dimensions, material, quantity per color, branding and packaging requirements. Confirm construction feasibility, tooling, costs and sample approval before placing a production order.
- Customization requests can include shapes and molds, acetate patterns, colors, logo printing or laser engraving, backing cards, hang tags and packaging. Suitable methods and availability depend on the selected material and construction.
- MOQ varies by product category and selected style; see the commercial facts below. Samples and in-stock items are discussed separately, with availability and order terms confirmed for each inquiry.
- Physical sampling takes approximately 15 days. Bulk production and shipping schedules are confirmed separately; no universal bulk-delivery window applies.
- For material, certification or inspection claims, request current documentation covering the exact material, product and intended destination. Do not infer certified status from a product or material name.

## Product categories

- [Custom hair claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/hair-claw-clips): Acetate, metal, plastic and resin claw clips with custom sizes, teeth, springs, colors and packaging.
- [Custom headbands](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/headbands): Padded, satin, velvet, knotted, braided and pearl headbands for private-label collections.
- [Custom scrunchies](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/scrunchies): Silk, satin, velvet and cotton scrunchies with custom sizing, elastic, labels and packaging.
- [Custom hair bows](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/hair-bows): Satin, grosgrain, oversized and multi-layer bows with custom clip hardware and branding.
- [Custom hair clips and barrettes](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/hair-clips-barrettes): Acetate, matte, pearl, crystal and flower clips and barrettes.

- [Cellulose acetate hair claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/claw-acetate): Custom acetate claw clips for private-label collections.
- [Butterfly hair claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/claw-butterfly): Decorative butterfly claw clips with custom colours and finishes.
- [Velvet scrunchies](https://wincomehair.com/products/scrunchie-velvet): Custom velvet scrunchies with logo and packaging options.
- [Silk scrunchies](https://wincomehair.com/products/scrunchie-silk): Private-label silk scrunchies in custom sizes and colours.
- [Braided velvet headbands](https://wincomehair.com/products/headband-braided): Padded and braided headbands for wholesale orders.
- [Bow hair clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/bow-clip): Custom fabric bow clips for retail and fashion brands.
- [Pearl cluster barrettes](https://wincomehair.com/products/clip-pearl-barrette): Pearl-decorated metal clips in custom sizes, layouts, frame tones and packaging.
- [Acetate snap hair clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/clip-acetate-snap): Patterned cellulose acetate snap clips and barrettes for private-label ranges.
- [Satin ribbon bow barrettes](https://wincomehair.com/products/bow-satin-barrette): Double-loop satin bows with custom colours, tails, clip backings and branding.
- [Resin butterfly claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/claw-butterfly-resin): Translucent resin butterfly claws with custom frame tones and decoration options.

## Selected product styles

- [Oversized polyester scrunchie](https://wincomehair.com/products/oversized-polyester-scrunchie): Regular fabric and larger satin options with separate outer diameters.
- [Mulberry silk scrunchie](https://wincomehair.com/products/mulberry-silk-scrunchie): Four listed widths with corresponding finished outer diameters.
- [Rhinestone satin scrunchie](https://wincomehair.com/products/rhinestone-satin-scrunchie): Polyester satin, hot-fix rhinestones, dimensions and care instructions.
- [Ruched wide fabric headband](https://wincomehair.com/products/ruched-wide-fabric-headband): Gathered elastic construction and listed flat dimensions.
- [Solid stretch fabric headband](https://wincomehair.com/products/solid-stretch-fabric-headband): Nylon-and-spandex fabric with a black elastic inner band.
- [Long crossed acrylic claw clip](https://wincomehair.com/products/long-crossed-acrylic-claw-clip): Listed dimensions 14 x 4 x 5 cm; listed weight 16 g.
- [Openwork ABS claw clip](https://wincomehair.com/products/openwork-abs-claw-clip): Listed dimensions 9 x 5 x 4.3 cm; listed weight 23 g.
- [Medium rounded PC claw clip](https://wincomehair.com/products/medium-rounded-pc-claw-clip): Listed dimensions 11 x 7 x 5 cm; listed weight 34 g.
- [Textured long-tail bow barrette](https://wincomehair.com/products/textured-long-tail-bow-barrette): Spring barrette, approximately 15 cm wide and 25 cm long including tails; finished weight is unconfirmed.
- [Long-tail velvet bow hair clip](https://wincomehair.com/products/long-tail-velvet-bow-hair-clip): Polyester velvet and a duckbill clip; finished dimensions and weight are unconfirmed.
- [Double-layer short-tail bow hair clip](https://wincomehair.com/products/double-layer-short-tail-bow-hair-clip): Duckbill clip, approximately 14 x 15 cm including tails; listed weight approximately 10 g.

The three selected claw clips have style-specific MOQ and unit-price quotations. Maximum jaw opening, effective gripping length and tooth spacing are not yet confirmed. Use samples to evaluate hold and fit; overall dimensions and photographs do not establish gripping capacity.

Production MOQ is 1,000 pieces for selected headbands and 1,500 pieces for selected scrunchies and hair bows. Samples and in-stock items can be discussed separately. Availability, customization and delivery timing are confirmed per inquiry.

## Commercial facts

- Custom Hair Claws & Clips production MOQ is 1,000 pieces per design per color for the standard custom catalog. The three selected claw styles use individual quotations instead.
- Custom Hair Clips & Barrettes production MOQ is 2,000 pieces per design per color.
- Headbands production MOQ is 1,000 pieces; scrunchies and hair bows production MOQ is 1,500 pieces. These minimums include the selected styles.
- Samples and in-stock items may be available below the custom production MOQ.
- Physical pre-production sampling takes about 15 days; shipping time is separate.
- Bulk production timing is confirmed separately based on the approved specifications, quantity and packaging.
- Custom services include product design, material selection, colour matching, logos, labels, cards, and gift boxes.
- Confirm shipping, payment, testing and any destination-specific requirements in the quotation and order terms.
